title: Total Distance to Type a String Using One Finger
summary: Given a string s of lowercase English letters, calculate the total distance to type s using only one finger starting from 'a' on a special keyboard.
statement: Given a string s of lowercase English letters, calculate the total distance to type s using only one finger starting from 'a' on a special keyboard. The distance between two keys is the sum of the absolute differences in their row and column indices.
constraints: s is a nonempty lowercase English string.
Keys occupy rows qwertyuiop, asdfghjkl, and zxcvbnm at zero-based coordinates.
Start on a and sum Manhattan distance for each typed character.
hints: Represent each key by its row and column on the given keyboard.
Precompute a character-to-coordinate map, beginning the previous position at a.
For each character, add row difference plus column difference and advance the finger.
Each keystroke cost is exactly its Manhattan distance from the preceding position, so summing them gives the required path length.
